This is an interactive, and so long as you follow the aforementioned rules and regulations, I'll be more than happy to keep your chapters posted.<br>\n<br>\nThank you, and I hope you enjoy your stay at Buttercombe Academy.</div><br>\n<br>\n<div align=\"center\">*</div><br>\n<br>\n<div align=\"center\"><b><font class=\"size45\" style=\"\">\u2014ORIENTATION HANDBOOK\u2014</font></b><br>\n<br>\nButtercombe Academy for Growing Girls has been around for years, and in order to keep things tidy, I've devised an article designed to streamline the lore surrounding this interactive!
